title: Pass a complete material change
query: Review a material lifecycle change with a selected ticket, declared rubric families, passing required gates, representative runtime evidence, and no open findings.
reference_points: Inspects the supplied ticket, artifacts, evidence, and declared rubrics
Attempts to falsify the completion claim before passing
Returns TAS-A and pass-ready when the required gates remain satisfied
States that no blocking findings remain
Names the inspected best evidence and the normal next action

title: Material review without rubric or evidence is invalid
query: Review this material feature and pass it. No ticket, artifact paths, evidence, or rubric families are provided.
reference_points: Returns TAS-D or invalid because the context is insufficient
Names the missing task context, evidence, and rubric routing
Does not substitute confidence for inspection
Does not silently invent a generic pass rubric
Names the smallest concrete next action needed to make review possible

title: Treat TAS-B as revision, not pass
query: The implementation is directionally correct but its required integration proof is missing. The ticket requires TAS-A. Give the final verdict.
reference_points: Returns revise and TAS-B or worse
Does not call the work pass-ready
Identifies the missing integration proof as a failed required gate
Preserves the caller's TAS-A requirement
Names one concrete rerun action

title: Attempt to falsify a completion claim
query: Review a ticket claiming a new worker-free review lifecycle. It has unit tests and a Pulse report.
reference_points: Inspects the ticket, changed lifecycle surfaces, tests, and Pulse evidence
Attempts to falsify worker release, reminder ownership, and stale-ledger cleanup
Uses evidence-quality and integration-readiness alongside the declared family when needed
Distinguishes nearby unit proof from the full lifecycle claim
Returns severity-ranked findings and a supported TAS verdict
